d:
In this video, we take a detailed *Ground Update of Package-05 of the Jabalpur Outer Ring Road Project.*
Package-05 is approximately *17 km long,* stretching from Amjhar Road to Barela,* & forms the final segment of the 114 km Jabalpur Outer Ring Road Project being developed around Jabalpur.
In this Ground Report, we cover the entire Package-05 & show the *actual construction progress,* including road formation, GSB work, major bridges, bridge piers & pier caps, water logging during the monsoon, sections where construction is still at an early stage, & the final section near *NH-30.*
